issue: Recurring /loop macro: Wave 7 research and implementation of clade-monitor signal safety and tmp-zero completion.
problem: clade-monitor registered SIGTERM/SIGINT via raw unsafe { libc::signal(...) }, which is async-signal-unsafe for application logic. It also wrote atomic-write test fixtures to /tmp and lacked a test-only clippy exemption for expect/unwrap.
fix: Replaced raw signal registration with signal-hook::flag::register on an Arc<AtomicBool> plus a watcher thread that propagates the flag to the existing RUNNING static. Added signal-hook dependency. Migrated atomic-write and missing-binary tests to tempfile::tempdir(). Added crate-level test exemption. ASCII-cleaned all touched lines and pre-existing non-ASCII characters in clade-monitor.
tests_added: No new tests; signal behavior covered by existing daemon semantics, tmp-zero tests migrated.
verification: cargo test -p clade-monitor --all-features passed 38 tests; cargo test --workspace --all-features passed; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features clean; ./build.sh OK; grep for /tmp in rings/RUST-*/src/main.rs returned zero matches; ASCII scan of changed files clean.
pattern: Replace raw libc::signal callbacks with signal-hook atomic flags and a watcher thread; use tempfile for test scratch directories; add test-only clippy exemption before it is needed.
anti_pattern: Do not register signal handlers with raw libc::signal for application logic; do not write test fixtures to /tmp; do not skip ASCII scan of the whole changed file.
